title: Hong Kong and Japan expand air cargo capacity through multimodal logistics

title: CXMT's server DRAM push raises margin concerns for Samsung, SK Hynix
content: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is raising concerns over the future pricing power of Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron as its plans for next-generation server DRAM prompt renewed scrutiny of competition in 2027 and 2028. South Korean industry observers caution, however, that CXMT has yet to demonstrate the production yields and reliability needed to challenge established suppliers at scale.

title: Taiwan panel makers enter semiconductor fight as structural challenges persist
content: Entering the fourth quarter of 2026, panel makers face pressure from rising component costs and weakening demand. However, price hikes and production cuts led by Chinese panel manufacturers are expected to prevent panel prices from falling further, while weak third-quarter revenue at AUO and Innolux highlights the need for Taiwanese manufacturers to accelerate their transformation.

title: Taisic Materials expands SiC capacity for AI data centers, 8-inch markets
content: Taisic Materials, a Foxconn-backed company under Kenmec Group, operates 65 crystal-growth furnaces as it expands silicon carbide (SiC) ingot and substrate production for AI data centers, advanced packaging, and high-frequency communications. The Taiwan-based materials supplier said the investment is intended to improve crystal quality, production stability, and yield while supporting growing demand for high-efficiency power and advanced thermal architectures.

title: Samsung sends yield engineers to Texas ahead of 2nm production ramp
content: Samsung Electronics has begun dispatching advanced-process yield engineers from South Korea to its Taylor, Texas, foundry ahead of planned 2nm chip volume production in 2027, South Korea's Financial News reported on October 12, citing industry sources.

title: AI substrate material shortages ease, but advanced equipment emerges as expansion bottleneck
content: As the customer base for AI accelerators expands rapidly and consumes IC substrate capacity, advanced packaging remains a critical industry bottleneck. Consequently, supply chain attention has shifted from upstream T-glass cloth used in copper-clad laminates (CCL) to the advanced manufacturing equipment required to expand IC substrate capacity.

title: SK Hynix unveils low-power processor design for SSDs
content: SK Hynix has unveiled a new processor architecture designed to reduce power consumption and chip area in solid-state drive (SSD) controllers, expanding its efforts to address storage bottlenecks as AI data centers demand faster and more efficient access to data.

title: Samsung's US$9B chip expansion faces funding, supply hurdles
content: Samsung affiliates plan to invest a combined KRW12.26 trillion (approx. US$9.18 billion) in semiconductor operations across South Korea and Vietnam, but the projects face different financial and supply-chain challenges. Samsung Electronics plans to finance about 63% of its Vietnamese memory testing investment through future profits, while Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEMCO) faces potential equipment delivery delays and material supply constraints as it expands semiconductor substrate production.

title: ATE Energy revenue jumps 132% on Philippines energy projects

title: ASML unveils Hyper NA EUV successor targeting 5nm single exposure
